turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit sore, ah, but manageable. My tummy hurts a little where they made the cuts.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understandable. On a scale of 1 to 10, what would you say your pain is right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 4 or 5? Not too bad, but I can feel it when I move.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, we’ll keep an eye on that. Any nausea or vomiting since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit of nausea, yes. Felt like I might throw up earlier, but it’s better now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Got it. We’ll give you something for that. How’s your breathing? Any discomfort in your throat or chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat’s a bit sore from the tube, I think. But I’m breathing fine, no trouble.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Do you remember anything from the operation itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, everything’s blank. Woke up here, so that’s good, right?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Since you have hypertension and GERD, any chest burning or high BP symptoms?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: BP’s been okay, but my throat feels a bit acidic, like usual. Not worse than before.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We’ll monitor your BP and give meds for the acid. You’re doing well overall.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Thanks, doctor. Hope to go home soon.
